about.kicker: A day built around good music and good smoke
paragraphs: Southern Star Festival brings live country music and a full-blown BBQ cookout together on one Hill Country farm for one day. Bring the family, bring your appetite, and settle in under the Texas sky for a lineup of Grammy award-winning and local artists, a finer-lickin' selection of BBQ, and local vendors all day long.
Whether you're here for the music, the meat, or both, there's shade, seating, and something going on from gates-open to the last encore.

location.title: Southern Star Farms
paragraphs: Maxwell, TX : about 20 minutes south of San Marcos and 45 minutes from both Austin and San Antonio. Parking on-site.
Coolers and outside drinks aren't permitted, but plenty of water stations and vendors will be on-site all day.

faq.q: Can I bring my own cooler or drinks?
faq.a: Outside food, drinks, and coolers aren't allowed, but there's plenty of food and drink from vendors and the cook-off tasting area all day.
Of course! Bring the paw-friends. You're completely responsible for cleaning, feeding, and making sure their safe!
There will be free on-site parking!

pageSections.heading: The Cheatham Street Music Foundation
paragraphs: The Cheatham Street Music Foundation is a nonprofit dedicated to preserving and promoting Texas music by nurturing the art, business, and craft of songwriting. Continuing Kent Finlay's legacy, the Foundation offers classes, workshops, and concerts that educate and inspire new generations of artists.

Building on the historic Cheatham Street Warehouse, where legends like George Strait and Stevie Ray Vaughan began, the organization fosters community connections and celebrates music's vital role in Texas culture.
